# Two selects and two datepickers in one component, and a select a render slot
# builds, on every target. gtk4's overrides name their widget (`#drop`, `#cal`)
# for an effect beside it to read, and every splice of an override shared the
# declaration's handle, so two of them were one handle rendered twice and the
# build refused the read; now each splice has its own (freshNodeHandles). And a
# select in a render slot read its signal's parameter as an unbound `d`: the
# slot's emitter spelled widget reads into native code before the attach said
# `d` was the dropdown, and readWidgets now leaves an attached handler's
# parameter for signalLambda.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import time "sngl:time"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component form ui.node {
    var shown = true
    var size = "S"
    var color = "Red"
    var extra = "No"
    var from option[time.date] = null
    var until option[time.date] = null

    ui.select #sizes(:value=size) {
        ui.choice(label="S")
        ui.choice(label="M")
    }
    ui.select #colors(:value=color) {
        ui.choice(label="Red")
        ui.choice(label="Blue")
    }
    if shown {
        ui.select #extras(:value=extra) {
            ui.choice(label="No")
            ui.choice(label="Yes")
        }
    }
    ui.datepicker(:value=from)
    ui.datepicker(:value=until)
}

func testEachSelectChoosesItsOwn(t test.Test, c form) {
    c.colors.change("Blue")
    t.assert(c.color == "Blue" && c.size == "S")
    c.sizes.change("M")
    t.assert(c.size == "M" && c.color == "Blue")
}

func testASelectInASlotChooses(t test.Test, c form) {
    if c.extras != null {
        c.extras.change("Yes")
    }
    t.assert(c.extra == "Yes")
}
